Graduate Software Developer

Company: Daifuku Oceania
Employment type: Full time
Location: Auckland

What you'll be doing
- Build and enhance quality applications using .NET and C#.
- Work in an Agile/Kanban team and deliver maintainable software.
- Support SQL-backed features and document your work.

Core Requirements
- Recent tertiary qualification in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
- Foundations in C#, .NET, SQL, and Git.
- Ability to communicate clearly and learn quickly.

Bonus Requirements
- Exposure to Azure or CI/CD pipelines.

Benefits
- Mentoring from senior engineers.
- Professional development support.

Application Notes
- Apply with your CV and academic transcript.
